tools.name: reamaze_list_conversations
tools.description: List/search conversations (support tickets). All filters optional; returns a page of conversations. Re:amaze REST: GET /conversations.

tools.name: reamaze_get_conversation
tools.description: Get a single conversation by its slug. Re:amaze REST: GET /conversations/{slug}.

tools.name: reamaze_list_messages
tools.description: List messages. If `conversation` (a slug) is given, list that conversation's messages (GET /conversations/{slug}/messages); otherwise list messages across the brand (GET /messages). All other filters optional. Re:amaze REST.

tools.name: reamaze_list_contacts
tools.description: List/search contacts (customers). All filters optional; returns a page of contacts. Re:amaze REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: reamaze_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact (customer) by identifier (email or id). Re:amaze REST: GET /contacts/{identifier}.

tools.name: reamaze_list_articles
tools.description: List/search help-center (knowledge-base) articles. All filters optional. Re:amaze REST: GET /articles.

tools.name: reamaze_get_article
tools.description: Get a single help-center article by its slug. Re:amaze REST: GET /articles/{slug}.

tools.name: reamaze_list_staff
tools.description: List staff (agent) accounts on the brand. Re:amaze REST: GET /staff.

tools.name: reamaze_list_channels
tools.description: List channels (inboxes: email, chat, social, etc.). Channel slugs are used as `category` filters. Re:amaze REST: GET /channels.

tools.name: reamaze_get_channel
tools.description: Get a single channel by its slug. Re:amaze REST: GET /channels/{slug}.

tools.name: reamaze_report_volume
tools.description: Get the conversation-volume report (counts over time). Both dates optional. Re:amaze REST: GET /reports/volume.

tools.name: reamaze_report_response_time
tools.description: Get the response-time report (how quickly conversations were answered). Both dates optional. Re:amaze REST: GET /reports/response_time.

tools.name: reamaze_create_conversation
tools.description: Create a new conversation (support ticket) with its first message. Re:amaze REST: POST /conversations.

tools.name: reamaze_reply_conversation
tools.description: Add a message to an existing conversation — a customer-facing reply or an internal note. Re:amaze REST: POST /conversations/{slug}/messages.

tools.name: reamaze_update_conversation
tools.description: Update fields on an existing conversation (subject, status, tags, assignee). Only provided fields change. Re:amaze REST: PUT /conversations/{slug}.

tools.name: reamaze_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (customer). Re:amaze REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: reamaze_update_contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact. Only provided fields change. Re:amaze REST: PUT /contacts/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reamaze_list_conversations, reamaze_list_messages, reamaze_get_contact, reamaze_list_channels · Private data: reamaze_list_contacts, reamaze_get_contact, reamaze_create_contact, reamaze_update_contact · Public sink: reamaze_get_contact, reamaze_list_channels, reamaze_create_conversation, reamaze_reply_conversation, reamaze_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reamaze_list_conversations, reamaze_list_messages, reamaze_get_contact, reamaze_list_channels · Private data: reamaze_list_contacts, reamaze_get_contact, reamaze_create_contact, reamaze_update_contact · Public sink: reamaze_get_contact, reamaze_list_channels, reamaze_create_conversation, reamaze_reply_conversation, reamaze_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
